classification.difficultyReason: Link the narrow cylindrical base to an initially constant height gradient, then the widening upper section to a decreasing positive gradient, distinguishing this from a curve that flattens from the outset.

inlines.text: The diagram shows a container, closed at the base.
It is to be filled with water at a constant rate.
Which graph best shows the depth of water in the container as time varies?

spec.sourceRegion: Question 5 container to the right of the stem
spec.description: Open broad elliptical rim above a continuously widening upper section and a narrow cylindrical lower section with a closed elliptical base. Outline-only house rendering.
spec.mathematics: The lower section has constant horizontal cross-section; above it, the horizontal cross-section increases with depth. No dimensions or water level are supplied.

spec.description: Option A: arrowed Depth and Time axes, without ticks or numerical scales.
spec.mathematics: Starts at the axes intersection with a straight increasing segment, followed by a smoothly increasing curve with decreasing gradient.
spec.answerVisibility: Permanent student-visible choice; no correctness mark.

spec.description: Option B: arrowed Depth and Time axes, without ticks or numerical scales.
spec.mathematics: Starts at the axes intersection with a straight increasing segment, followed by an increasing curve with increasing gradient.
spec.answerVisibility: Permanent student-visible choice; no correctness mark.

spec.description: Option C: arrowed Depth and Time axes, without ticks or numerical scales.
spec.mathematics: Starts at the axes intersection and increases with decreasing gradient throughout; there is no initial straight segment.
spec.answerVisibility: Permanent student-visible choice; no correctness mark.

spec.description: Option D: arrowed Depth and Time axes, without ticks or numerical scales.
spec.mathematics: Starts at the axes intersection nearly horizontally and increases with increasing gradient throughout.
spec.answerVisibility: Permanent student-visible choice; no correctness mark.

answer.worked: In the narrow cylindrical section, the cross-section is constant, so the depth increases at a constant rate. Above this section, the container widens, so the depth continues to increase at a decreasing rate. Correct answer: A.
